parsed.name: 化学气相沉积（CVD）设备控制系统
parsed.description: 用于化学气相沉积实验装置的工艺控制界面，通常围绕温度与多路气体流量配方进行设置、运行和监控。可在实验中管理配方文件、下发设定值并观察过程趋势曲线，支持薄膜生长等CVD工艺流程。
parsed.description_en: A process control interface for a chemical vapor deposition (CVD) setup, typically handling temperature and multi-gas flow recipes for run control and monitoring. It is used in lab workflows to manage recipe files, apply setpoints, and view process trend plots during CVD thin-film growth experiments.

actions.description: 返回当前界面中的工艺参数字段值。
actions.description_en: Return the current process-parameter field values from the UI.

actions.description: 保存当前CVD工艺配方到文件（含元数据与参数表）。
actions.description_en: Save the current CVD process recipe to a file (including metadata and parameter table).

actions.description: 从文件打开并加载CVD工艺配方到控制界面。
actions.description_en: Open a CVD process recipe file and load it into the control interface.

actions.description: 更新工艺趋势图（如各路气体流量随时间变化）。
actions.description_en: Update the process trend plots (such as time-varying gas flow channels).

actions.description: 启动配方运行并开始过程监控。
actions.description_en: Start recipe execution and begin process monitoring.

actions.description: 应用温度/流量等工艺设定值到系统。
actions.description_en: Apply process setpoints (e.g., temperature/flow) to the system.
